description: This Java source file defines the class MacroSource which implements the SubstitutionSource interface, functioning as a key-value store for macro substitutions with methods to add mappings and retrieve variables.

classes.name: MacroSource
classes.description: A class that implements a substitution source using a HashMap to store string key/value pairs, providing methods to add mappings and retrieve variables.
